productQuality.shortcut: Connect each business question to its evidence, limits and operating tools.
productQuality.title: Product quality observatory
productQuality.subtitle: Find the business question, evidence source and limits of each module without mixing consented data, internal aggregates and technical metrics.

principle.title: Read signals without overstating them
principle.description: A raw volume is never enough. Combine funnel, reliability and qualitative feedback before expanding, fixing or stopping a feature.
principle.privacy: No identity or raw data is brought together on this page.

channels.mixed: Consented analytics and separate internal monitoring

rank.title: Trustworthy rankings
rank.question: Do rankings remain understandable and reliable when evidence is weak?
rank.evidence: Diagnostics for evidence, exclusions, policy versions and rebuilds.
rank.limit: Methodology opens remain reserved: view volume does not measure trust.

pass.title: Visit passport
pass.question: Does the Passport provide enough value to lead to a second recorded visit?
pass.evidence: Aggregated first- and second-visit cohort, completions and daily trend.
pass.limit: The north star replaces neither interviews nor checks on entered data quality.

share.title: Controlled sharing
share.question: Are shares deliberately published, viewed and then revoked without loss of control?
share.evidence: Consented funnel in Matomo; moderation and revocations in the internal module.
share.limit: Sources remain separate: no share identifier may be used to connect them.

fit.title: Park Fit recommendations
fit.question: Does the recommendation complete despite unknown data?
fit.evidence: Starts, completions, drop-offs, no-result cases, unknowns and reports.
fit.limit: A high completion rate alone does not validate the relevance of results.

watch.title: Factual alerts
watch.question: Do alerts arrive on time, once only and without misleading people?
watch.evidence: Aggregated deliveries, duplicates, latency, failures, queue and reports.
watch.limit: Alert volume or email clicks are never a goal on their own.

trip.title: Collaborative trips
trip.question: Can groups record preferences and then reach a usable decision?
trip.evidence: Aggregated collaborative plans, preferences, decisions and audit markers.
trip.limit: No participant, destination or exact choice is exposed in metrics.

hist.title: Stories and timelines
hist.question: Is historical coverage sufficiently sourced to be understood?
hist.evidence: Diagnostics for snapshots, sources, inconsistencies and processing.
hist.limit: Opening a timeline never constitutes historical evidence.

live.title: Live data
live.question: Does live data remain fresh, available and reliable enough to display?
live.evidence: Freshness, providers, circuits, quarantines and forecast accuracy.
live.limit: No park, attraction, exact wait time or location enters product analytics.
